title: The app is perfect!
body:
If you’ve read the book “Atomic Habits” by James Clear, you’ll love this app! If not, you’ll still get main insights and you will like the app and will build the good habits and break the bad ones with time. 
P.S. app was updated and there’s no more bugs. Thanks to developer for the answer!🙌🏼🙏🏼
author: Veyrith

title: How do you log missed days?
body: This is silly I know but I cannot log days I forgot to add. I’ve completed 5 days and I don’t like looking at my record that says I’ve done 2! I know the goal is to finish my book but I’ve put those hours in and I want it on record!
author: Big Pink Freak

title: Great design, horrendous pricing model.
body: €20 per month subscription for the majority of the useful features is equal parts ludicrous and disappointing. I’d happily pay for a good service, but €20 per month is crazy man. I’ll read the book again and track my habits via a cheaper alternative app instead.
author: Siiiime

title: Great simple concept to stay motivated!
body: Love the simplicity of how this app makes me want to take action on small habits. Thank you James Clear!
author: Ariadne642

title: Potentially one of the best out there
body: I know it’s only been released for a day but the app keeps closing itself and it’s hard to get into the features because of it. I’m sure that will be fixed as it is brand new but I am excited to see it progress
author: Your buddy, Fin Brennan

title: Unable to change US weeks & time format
body:
The app only has American date & time standards, a week start on Sunday (sic!) and only has AM / PM time format instead of 24h clock. The week especially is confusing. 

If you want it to become "global" app you need to cater for other audiences than just one country.

Also only 3 habits in a Pro version for €120/ year? There are many habit tracking apps that allow you track as many as you want, this seems pretty limiting.

On a plus side, nice user interface and excerpts from the book
author: Bryan Cowen

title: The icing on the cake!
body: This is a fantastic app geared towards taking action bit by bit. Loved the book Atomic Habits, highly recommend this app as the perfect champion companion to achieving your goals. Thank you James Clear.
author: Emerald34

title: Just started
body: I like the look of the app so far, looking forward to getting started logging. Full of interesting content too.
